title: Rice MMKG: a Rice Multimodal Knowledge Graph
description: Rice MMKG is a knowledge graph for rice disease and pest diagnosis that separates an annotation layer (what a source dataset asserts), an observation layer (multimodal evidence: images, sensor readings, textual reports), and a domain layer (diseases, pathogens, pests, symptoms, and management knowledge). The evidence layer (captures/indicates) and the annotation layer (annotatedAs/denotes) are kept independent so the two can be compared rather than conflated.
